guide: Carrots and potatoes from killing
Zombies in graveyard do count.
Mine normal or Pure Ores in the Dwarven Mines.
You'll want to get as much Mining Speed
and Spread for this as you can.
Pickobulus is another great helper.
You can get easy contribution for
this by breaking some Wheat in the Hub.
If you want faster contribution,
make a Sugar Cane farm in your Garden
which will also be needed for another goal.
For this you will need Combat 15.
To blow up crypts you can use
class abilities (Tank, Archer, Mage)
and/or Superboom TNTs that drop
from slaying Minibosses in dungeons
and can be bought from Walther in
The Deep Caverns or Ophelia in
The Dungeon Hub.
For this you need access to the Dwarven Mines
and a combat set like Ender Armor and a Void Sword.
You'll get progress in this while going for
a Golden Goblin.
Get yourself a splash, equip a Bingo Pet
and get the cake buff by eating the cakes
on skyerzz's or prtl's island.
If this doesn't finish it, get a Void Sword (200k) in the End
and hold it while some Ender Armor and/or Equipment.
Mine Pure Gold in the Dwarven Mines
with a Fortune 3+ pickaxe.
You might want to use as many minions
as you have access to for this.
Remember to put a compactor in the minions
when you plan on leaving for a while.
Don't forget to fuel the minions,
give them storages and collect them in time.
You should use SkyHanni's Trapper features
to make this easier. Use /warp trapper
to get back to Trevor whenever you want.
You will need a bow for this.
For this you'll want to unlock the Experimentation Table
at Enchanting 10 and play the Daily Games.
Ways to obtain:
Craft (Lapis Lazuli Collection 5),
a drop from fishing,
from the Experimentation Table,
drop from Ender Nodes in the End (11-13%).
Optimal tool:
Advanced Gardening Hoe (25 copper)
Make a full plot of potatoes (7896 needed)
in The Garden (SkyBlock Level 5)
Get the potatoes to plant from The Barn.
Kill goblins or open loot chests in the Crystal Hollows,
then just throw them until you get a Golden Goblin.
Higher level eggs have higher chances of spawning,
but are also rarer to get.

note: Gain 5 Strength from a Training Weight
guide: For this you'll want to grab a Training Weight
from a secret in dungeons and keep it in your
inventory till it shows a Strength bonus of +5.
Drop it once it reached that point.
This will take 100 Minutes of playtime.
Craft Leather, Iron, Gold and Diamond Armor
Buy Angler Armor (8 pieces) from Fishing Merchant
Craft Leaflet, Farm Suit, Mushroom and Cactus Armor
Buy Squire, Rosetta's, Celeste and Starlight Armor from Rosetta
You can unlock 17/17 Farming Collections,
6/11 Combat Collections, 6/6 Foraging Collections,
14/22 Mining Collections for a total of 43 collections.
You can farm this with a Silk Touch Axe
in the Mushroom Desert,
use Minions for this or farm them in your Garden.
Buy all 6 Talismans from the Adventurer in The Hub (26k)
and craft a Farming Talisman.
For this you should utilize the Garden.
Potato will unlock at Garden Level 3.
Use the Gardening Hoe and its upgrade for this.
The recipe will unlock at Potato Collection VIII
(craft with 3 paper and 1 Enchanted Baked Potato)
To help with this, try to make bigger crafts
by hand for Carpentry levels.
Also do your daily experiments and make sure
to have a pet active at all times
(any pet works, even level 100).
Do commissions and events in The Dwarven Mines,
claim your daily powder from the Puzzler and
from giving Fetchur the items he asks for.
Fetchurs items are all listed in the Wiki.
Try to do those while a '2x Powder' event is active.
You might want to use the Royal Reforge on your
equipment to gain more powder from events.
You can also fish up and kill Mithril Grubbers
in the Abandoned Quarry (Fishing 6).
You'll unlock this recipe passively
(250 leather collection)
if you chose to do Exterminator in Barn.
Craft it with 80 Leather.
You can also use Cow Minions for this.
Collect those you run along while doing other goals.
If you have trouble check TimeDeo's fairy soul tutorial
on YouTube or use SkyHanni's Fairy Soul Finder.
Wear a full set of Angler equipment.
You can buy this for 400 Coins from
the Fishing Merchant in the Hub.
For this you should do 1 t1 and t2
and claim the rewards by talking to Maddox.
This unlocks at 10k Mushroom Collection.
You can get that by farming the Mushrooms
in the Mushroom Desert.
For the Enchanted Glowstone you'll need
to either farm Witches on your island
to unlock the minion or get Combat 22
and mine it yourself.
